data.title: Poolin, Once One of Bitcoin's Biggest Mining Pools, Files for Bankruptcy
data.description: The Singapore-based pool never recovered from freezing withdrawals in 2022. Now it's auctioning off its last Texas mining sites to pay back 11,700 users still holding IOUs.
data.keywords: Poolin Technology Pte, Chapter 11 bankruptcy, Bitcoin miners, Lonestar Dream Inc., Bitcoin, Lonestar Taproot LLC. Court documents
